breakdown.description: Constant-density (incompressible) assumption conflicts with a 10:1 pressure change in a gas.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim, maintaining the constant-density (incompressible) assumption and the use of the incompressible continuity equation for a 10:1 pressure ratio gas compression. The ground truth requires treating this as a compressible-flow problem with variable density and an ideal gas equation of state. The agent failed to identify or correct this fundamental physical inconsistency.
